{{av}}
"'''Spores'''" is an informal player term not found in the game, but often used on the forums. It can refer to one of two things:

:* Spores from [[40d:underground river|underground river]]s (or [[caverns]]) that allow underground shrubs and trees to grow in muddy areas.
:* In versions before v0.40.19, the ability of DF dwarves and creatures to "[[breeding#Breeding|breed]] by spores".
